title: the cast door's shape check leaves transitions so the verdict path stops reaching the bus
intention: The inspector's verdict path stops reaching gate_probes and the bus: the cast door's plan-shape check moves out of transitions.py into cairn/tools/base/plan_shape.py, which imports only the standard library, and rehearsal imports it from there.
why: Measured 2026-11-16 by akienasus_cc_0 at 5dc2364a8adb's reseal 8b7a52513: test_the_fire_path_never_reaches_the_tree sealed red, because inspector.py imports rehearsal, and rehearsal (since 4be9's commit 2e1efde34) imports transitions._shape_lacks, which pulls in gate_probes (socket) and inspect_wire (the bus and its store). 5dc2 is held at PROVEME by it.
traces_to: Law 3 and the inspector's charter: a verdict that can consult a host or a database is an opinion wearing a measurement's clothes. Law 9: 5dc2 is held red by it.
how: Cut _CAST_REQUIRED, _CAST_ID, _blank and the block from _ISO_DATE to the end of _shape_lacks out of transitions.py verbatim into plan_shape.py; transitions re-imports every name so its callers are unchanged; rehearsal._shape imports from plan_shape; test_inspector_nexus declares PROVES for the tooth.

clauses.claim: over the live import graph, catches(graph, inspector._FIRE_PATH) is [] with no allowance added, so the verdict path reaches no bus, socket or db door

decisions.text: D1: plan_shape.py holds the shape check verbatim and imports only json, re and pathlib; transitions.py re-imports _CAST_ID, _CAST_REQUIRED, _ISO_DATE, _blank, _outcome_lacks, _paths_ok, _resolves and _shape_lacks from it.
D2: rehearsal._shape imports _shape_lacks from plan_shape, so rehearsal no longer reaches transitions.
D3: test_inspector_nexus.py declares PROVES {efcb2efe7dd3: {1: test_the_fire_path_never_reaches_the_tree}}; the tooth itself is unchanged.
